title: The Debiased Score Test: Hunt-and-test for Semiparametric Hypotheses
abstract: arXiv:2607.28861v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The parametric score test assesses a hypothesis through derivatives of the log-likelihood, whose expectation vanishes under the null. When the parameter of interest is a regression function identified as a risk minimiser, we extend this idea to test whether it belongs to a given linear function class. This yields goodness-of-fit tests for common semiparametric regression models, including generalised additive and partially linear models. Suitably formulated, the framework also detects effect modifiers in observational studies. We propose a hunt-and-test strategy that splits the data into two: on one part, after fitting the null model, machine learning is used to identify a promising direction in the empirical scores; on the other, we test whether the score vanishes in that direction. translated_title: 去偏得分检验：面向半参数假设的“搜寻-检验”方法
translated_abstract: 参数得分检验通过对数似然函数的导数来评估假设，其在原假设成立时期望为零。当感兴趣的参数是被识别为风险最小化子的回归函数时，我们将这一思想扩展到检验该函数是否属于某个给定的线性函数类。由此得到了针对常见半参数回归模型的拟合优度检验，包括广义可加模型和部分线性模型。经过适当表述，该框架还可以用于检测观察性研究中的效应修饰因子。我们提出了一种“搜寻-检验”策略，将数据分为两部分：在其中一部分数据上，先拟合原假设模型，再利用机器学习在经验得分中识别出一个有希望的方向；在另一部分数据上，我们检验得分在该方向上是否为零。为了考虑估计原假设模型时产生的误差，我们应用了基于加权最小二乘投影的去偏校正。我们建立了第I类错误……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种“搜寻-检验”策略的去偏得分检验方法：用一部分数据借助机器学习搜寻得分的最优方向，用另一部分数据检验得分是否为零，并通过加权最小二乘投影进行去偏校正，从而实现对半参数回归模型的拟合优度检验及观察性研究中效应修饰因子的检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a debiased score test with a hunt-and-test strategy: machine learning hunts for a promising direction in empirical scores on one data split, the score is tested along that direction on the other, and a weighted least squares debiasing correction accounts for null model estimation error, enabling goodness-of-fit tests for semiparametric regression models and detection of effect modifiers in observational studies.
